queries.missing_physical_ids: SELECT source_object,source_row::BIGINT source_row FROM raw_envelopes EXCEPT SELECT source_object,source_row FROM output_ids
queries.extra_physical_ids: SELECT source_object,source_row FROM output_ids EXCEPT SELECT source_object,source_row::BIGINT FROM raw_envelopes
queries.repeated_or_overlapping_physical_ids: SELECT source_object,source_row,count(*) n FROM output_ids GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)<>1
queries.repeated_curated_record_ids: SELECT record_id,count(*) n FROM candidate GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)<>1
